name: Jeżyk
flavour: The little hedgehog of the block. Slow to start, impossible to stop.
art_prompt: a lean young man with a bald head and smooth blue skin, a stern focused face with sharp eyebrows, dark eyes and slightly large ears, wearing a black zip-up track jacket with a high collar, a thin silver zip down the front and two white stripes running down each sleeve, black track pants with two white stripes running down the outside of each leg, black sneakers with thick white soles; standing straight, both arms relaxed at his sides, empty hands
motion: running in place at a fast determined sprint, arms pumping at his sides, empty hands
anim_hint: a bald blue-skinned man in a black zip-up tracksuit with two white stripes down the sleeves and down the legs, black sneakers with white soles, a fast determined sprint with the arms pumping
anim_negative: hair, antlers, a hat, a hood, a beard, extra limbs, a face on the back of the head, text, logos
portrait_prompt: head and shoulders of a bald blue-skinned young man with a stern half-smirk and one eyebrow raised, the high collar of his black track jacket zipped up to the chin, the white stripes on his shoulders, facing the viewer
hurt_hint: flinching with his teeth gritted and his eyes squeezed shut, one arm raised across the chest
trait_text: Starts 15% slower. While he is not hit his charge climbs over 10 s to +80% speed, +60% attack damage and +20% evade chance; a hit that lands knocks off half of it.
back_hint: He faces away from the viewer: only the back of his bald blue head and ears, the back of the black track jacket with the two white stripes running down both sleeves, the white stripes down the legs and the white soles of the sneakers are visible; no eyes, no face at all. Both arms hang straight down along his sides, relaxed, empty hands.
appearance: a lean young man with a bald head and smooth blue skin, a stern focused face with sharp eyebrows, dark eyes and slightly large ears, wearing a black zip-up track jacket with a high collar, a thin silver zip down the front and two white stripes running down each sleeve, black track pants with two white stripes running down the outside of each leg, black sneakers with thick white soles
side_hint: a clean side profile facing right: the bald blue head and its ear, the high jacket collar, the two white stripes running down the near sleeve and the near leg; both shoulders level, the near shoulder never raised above the far one, the near arm hanging relaxed beside the torso, empty hands
pose_hint: standing straight, weight on both feet, both arms relaxed at the sides, empty hands
title_pose: standing with his feet apart and his hands pushed deep into the pockets of his black track jacket, his shoulders a little hunched, a stern unimpressed stare with one eyebrow raised, the jacket zipped up to the collar, the white stripes down his sleeves and legs facing the viewer
title_holds: his hands hold nothing; they are in his jacket pockets
